items.title: Exponential lower bounds for bounded-repetition semantic branching programs solving amplified Flow search formulas
items.author: Anastasia Sofronova; Dmitry Sokolov
items.source_version: Official complete25-pageCCC2021 publication,2021-07-08; mainTheorem2/restated13, completeSection4 author proof, requiredSections2–3 and entireAppendicesA/B
items.difficulty_reason: The authors combine a bounded-repetition garland argument with strongly satisfied closure assignments, amplify Flow clauses to force structured repetitions, and use both local expander bounds and a global max-flow cut analysis to obtain the contradiction.

proof_spans.label: Original garland definition, exact Flow/amplification model and all induction parameters pp.17:7–10
Complete actual local/global Max-Flow argument and originalFigures2–4 pp.17:14–18
Entire originalAppendicesA/B deferred closure and path-garland proofs pp.17:21–25

contexts.label: Faithful original search/assignment/BP/expander definitions and bearing lemmas pp.17:2,17:4–7
